deploy_local: The hub machine updates along with the hub
deploy_upgrade_first: Upgrade the node service on this computer once first. After that you can update it remotely from here
deploy_offline: This computer is offline. Update it once it reconnects
node_no_model_config: This computer’s node doesn’t support model config yet. Update the node
node_protocol_old: This computer’s node speaks an older protocol than its assistant. Update the node
node_protocol_new: This computer’s node needs a newer assistant. Update the hub
node_no_engine_hosts: This computer’s node can’t choose an engine for new sessions yet. Update the node
node_no_secret_run: This computer’s node can’t run commands from a password card yet. Update the node
node_no_assistant_config_dir: This computer’s node can’t select an assistant profile yet. Update the node
node_no_assistant_service_tier: This computer’s node can’t apply Fast from a conversation’s first message yet. Update the node
node_no_secret_env: This computer’s node can’t take secrets for an Agent start: update it, and run it as a resident node (Persona Link, or personad node --attach)
node_no_launcher_switch: This computer’s node can’t switch a running agent to another model provider yet. Update the node
node_no_launcher_switch_now: This computer’s node can’t move a running agent to another model provider for Persona yet. Update the node
node_no_model_http: This computer’s node can’t send model requests yet. Update the node
node_no_engine_switch: This computer’s node can’t switch a running agent between Claude Code and Codex yet. Update the node
node_no_model_run: This computer’s node can’t answer model requests with a launcher yet. Update the node
